title: The Two Sides of the Coin: Hallucination Generation and Detection with LLMs as Evaluators for LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of model explanations in a machine translation hallucination detection task, specifically examining how the model handles gender-specific nouns (e.g., German words 'Wirtschaftsprüferin' and 'Sekretärin') and whether it makes incorrect gender assumptions when evaluating translations.
